# Test-fixture rights

`cc0-cat.jpg` is a CC0 image from Wikimedia Commons used only to exercise the pinned OpenCV DNN model and deterministic crop geometry. The source page, creator/uploader field, CC0 identifier, original and packaged byte lengths, SHA-256 values, privacy transform and permitted scope are recorded in `provenance.json`.

No user-supplied GraceWays or Molly image is included.
